It cuts across RC-C3 (routing/destinations), RC-C6/RC-C10 (mid-call continuity), RC-C5 (draft/compose continuity) and RC-C9 (platform lifecycle). NOT_RECORDED as any chapter's obligation.' Agent B reaches it independently: the shared-cause continuity contract is one of four partly independent dependency systems and 'has NO owning chapter on any axis'.
mandatedItemResponses.refinementThatMatters: The obligation did not vanish - it was DISTRIBUTED, and distributed in a form that cannot accumulate into an authority. Read the four chapters' scopes together: RC-C1 PRESERVE 'existing auth flows, session handling, backend contracts'; RC-C3 PRESERVE 'session continuity (floating_call_widget, incoming_live_overlay, thread_call_lifecycle_host)'; RC-C5 PRESERVE 'DRAFTS AND DRAFT DATA'; RC-C9 BUILD 'active realtime continuity' and background/foreground. meaningForTheCompletenessOfTheReconstruc: The axis is INCOMPLETE, not wrong. Its governing thesis is AUTHORITIES BEFORE SURFACES (DOCTRINE-AUTHORITIES-BEFORE-SURFACES defines RC-C0..RC-C11). The gap is chronological and should be read without blame. The roadmap froze 2026-08-15. REFRESH IS NOT NAVIGATION was frozen as a founder platform contract on 2026-08-17 and is recorded as AUDITED, NOT IMPLEMENTED. RC-C0 closed before the contract existed.

FD-13 states there is no standalone enforcement chapter; the roadmap states approval is not authorisation to begin a chapter; nothing states how a fourth foundation enters. summary.structuralStatement: The disappearance is not random. Every disappeared obligation shares one property: it produced no finding. Duplication debt, unbuilt-but-frozen backend capability, naming and vocabulary obligations, deferred decisions, demolition inventories, exit gates and founder checkpoints are all invisible to a taxonomy whose organising question is 'what would have to become correct for this finding to stop recurring'. Both axes are correct; neither is sufficient alone. That is the reconciliation this artifact exists to record.

This is the decision that determines whether the portfolio is a reconstruction plan or a defect plan.

Does the portfolio need a DUPLICATION-RETIREMENT class? DR1 (eight attention surfaces), DR2 (one live-rooms screen), DR3 (six composers, eleven upload pipelines, 25 paste files) and RC-C6's Meetings convergence (3,890 lines, 0 of 5 shared widgets) are all chartered demolitions that produce no findings, because duplication has no single observable symptom.

G5 168 sites / 67 files, 181 state primitives, 47 toLocal(), the 11-caller relative_time shim, R1's 85 role-derived booleans and C3's 294 literal sites are all gate-enforced against growth and owned per-chapter. They cannot regress; they can stop shrinking forever if the receiving structure disappears.

How does the portfolio carry RC-C10's TWO EXIT GATES if its findings are split across CH-C, CH-G and CH-H? Each system can complete without the chapter's construction exit ('no temporary authorities anywhere') or its cross-platform completion gate ever being evaluated.

Where do FOUNDER CHECKPOINTS live in the portfolio? VD-081 lists nine standing checkpoints that gate Product-Behavior certification and that no implementation may pre-empt. RC-C4's is explicitly required BEFORE the eight DR1 surfaces are retired - a sequencing constraint inside a chapter, not between chapters.

Does CH-E Identity Consumption become a CHAPTER or a CERTIFICATION LAYER? Its consumers live on surfaces owned by chapters that have not run, so as a chapter it re-opens every time a later chapter builds a new consumer; as a layer it attaches to each chapter's own definition of done. The evidence supports either and does not choose.

This reconciliation adds one datum: VD-041 (Live engagement), VD-042 (public preview) and the whole of RC-C4 are counted as validation obligations against capabilities the RC axis records as entirely unbuilt.

How is a NEW CROSS-CUTTING AUTHORITY admitted after RC-C0 has closed? The axis's thesis is authorities before surfaces; it enumerated them once; and the continuity contract was frozen two days after the roadmap. Whatever Stage 3 decides about CH-A specifically, the admission mechanism is missing and will be needed again.

F137 - no uploaded media of any kind is scanned - has no home on any axis: no RC chapter, no RIC stage, no doctrine, no gap record. Does Stage 3 carry an unowned security obligation with two findings of evidence, or does it wait for more findings on a surface nobody is exercising?
